page_title: CAG 1-2 SAS | Cagliari v Sassuolo 30/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Elia Caprile (Cagliari) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+6' Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo) has tested the patience of referee Luca Pairetto and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+5' Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) tries to find Alieu Fadera, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
90+4' Sassuolo couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Elia Caprile (Cagliari) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
90+3' The total number of attempts is 8:11.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) has tested the patience of referee Luca Pairetto and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
89' The game has begun to heat up. Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
89' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

87' A cross by Mattia Felici (Cagliari) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
86' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) was quite harsh and Luca Pairetto didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cristian Volpato departs the field of play to be replaced by Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo).
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo) for Ismael Kone.
83' Fabio Pisacane has decided to substitute Sebastiano Esposito and he is replaced by Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michel Adopo leaves the pitch and Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) comes on.
83' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
82' Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) makes a strong challenge and Luca Pairetto blows for a foul. Cagliari are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
81' Wow, what an escape. Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
80' Luca Pairetto couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) and blew his whistle.

78' OFF THE POST! Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) coming on for Gennaro Borrelli.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch so that Kristian Thorstvedt can be given a rest.
74' Fabio Grosso has decided to make a change. Luca Moro (Sassuolo) replaces Andrea Pinamonti.
74' Today's match ends for Armand Lauriente who will be replaced by Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo).
73' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) receives a precise pass inside the box from Mattia Felici and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
72' An attempted cross from Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) is cleared.
70' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
68' The current number of shots on goal is 0:4.
65' Luca Pairetto sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
65' The Sassuolo players halt their celebrations as referee Luca Pairetto makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
65' 0 - 2 Goal! Cristian Volpato provides Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
62' Fabio Pisacane decides to make a substitution. Michael Folorunsho will be replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
62' Here comes a substitution. Mattia Felici (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Gabriele Zappa.
61' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

60' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. The ball goes behind for a corner. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
60' Cagliari take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

59' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Cagliari.
58' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Adam Obert (Cagliari) for his blatant foul.
57' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.

56' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
54' 0 - 1 Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and sends the ball into the top right corner. What a stunning goal!

54' It seems like Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is about to take a free kick. The goalkeeper has to be alert and careful how to position the defensive wall. This is the perfect distance for a direct shot.
53' Adam Obert (Cagliari) makes a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul. Sassuolo earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
51' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
50' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

49' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Sassuolo will have a corner.
48' Sassuolo take a short corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.
43' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sassuolo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' Elia Caprile blocks Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo)'s effort from the edge of the box.
41' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sassuolo comes to nothing.
40' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
39' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
39' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
37' Yellow card. Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
35' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
32' Luca Pairetto has a clear sight and sees a foul from Fali Cande (Sassuolo).
30' 41:59 – the latest ball possession ratio.
28' The goal by Cagliari is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
28' The Cagliari players joy may have been justified, because referee Luca Pairetto is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
28' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) has a goal ruled out for offside!
27' Cagliari are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

25' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) picks up a long through ball, but Arijanet Muric deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Cagliari.
24' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
23' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
22' That looked a certain handball by Fali Cande (Sassuolo) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
20' The resulting corner from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Sassuolo are awarded a corner kick.
20' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes it short.
18' Sassuolo couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Elia Caprile (Cagliari) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
15' Wonderful movement by Sassuolo. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
12' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Pairetto had an easy-decision to make.
11' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Matteo Prati (Cagliari), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
11' A poor mid-range free-kick by Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is easily blocked by the defensive wall. The referee points to the corner flag and Cagliari will take a corner.
10' Fali Cande (Sassuolo) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
10' The Cagliari players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
7' Neat link-up play between Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) and Sebastiano Esposito, but Arijanet Muric reads the game well and the move breaks down.

6' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
5' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) brings an opponent down and Luca Pairetto interrupts the game. Cagliari have a free kick.
5' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
3' Cagliari players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
2' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Sassuolo will take the kick-off.
